Replacing components
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Use ``replace`` to change selected components without changing the original
version. Unspecified components are preserved; ``None`` removes optional
prerelease or build metadata.

.. code-block:: python

    >>> semver.replace('1.2.3-rc.1+build.4', patch=5, prerelease=None)
    '1.2.5+build.4'
    >>> version_info.replace(major=4, build=None)
    VersionInfo(major=4, minor=4, patch=5, prerelease='pre.2', build=None)

Command-line interface
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Run ``python -m semver`` (or the ``./pysemver`` launcher in a source checkout):

.. code-block:: console

    $ python -m semver compare 1.2.3 2.0.0
    -1
    $ python -m semver bump patch 1.2.3
    1.2.4
    $ python -m semver check 1.2.3

``check`` produces no output for a valid version. Invalid versions produce an
error on standard error and exit status 2. Use ``--help`` to see the available
commands. Applications can also use ``createparser()``, ``process(args)``, and
``main(cliargs=None)`` directly; ``main`` returns the exit status.
EOF
python -m doctest docs/usage.rst
git diff --check
git status --short
